description: This file 'apply.c' appears to be a C source file from the Git version control system, specifically related to patch application functionality. It includes numerous headers and defines functions for parsing, applying, and managing patches, diffs, and related data structures. The comments and function names indicate that it handles patch parsing, whitespace checking, binary patch processing, and diff header analysis.

classes.name: gitdiff_data
classes.description: Structure to hold diff parsing state, including root directory buffer, line number, and p-value used in diff processing.

classes.name: image
classes.description: Represents a file's contents as lines with associated hash and flags, used for patch application comparisons.
